# Phone numbers that may appear in tracked files, listed by SHA-256 only (#358).
#
# Format: <sha256 of the E.164 string, e.g. sha256("+1...")>  <label>
# Labels say why a number is allowed. They must never contain the number.
#
# Twilio magic test numbers (+1500555xxxx), NANP fiction numbers (NXX-555-01xx)
# and strings that cannot be a dialable NANP number are allowed by rule in
# tests/test_no_personal_numbers.py and need no entry here.
#
# To add an entry: printf '%s' '+1XXXXXXXXXX' | shasum -a 256
# Never add a personal number. Use a Twilio magic number in tests instead.
